title: Husk House

steps.prompt: A small one-room cottage built from curved pale husk panels and timber, round door, thatched roof, a crooked chimney, flower box under a round window. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 7000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 4.50 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/concepts/con_envkit_husk_house.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=3801 final_tris=3800 dims=4.500x3.757x4.185 tex=2048. Made with TRELLIS.2. Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
